integrity: The new claim is supported by an explicit argument using a clopen-neighbourhood ultrafilter and stalks commuting with filtered colimits. No external or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only zero-dimensional Hausdorff spaces, the (epi, mono) factorisation, and ultraproduct covering, not full enriched compactness. Prior results cover non-surjectivity for Cantor/Stone spaces and R; a broader localic statement may exist.
title: Discreteness characterizes ultraproduct covering for zero-dimensional sheaf topoi
